verdict.rationale: LobeHub's own docs say you can connect external agents, "including coding CLIs," set up a local Agent on your machine through a guided wizard, and use a desktop terminal. This is a first-party path to supervising real coding agents rather than only producing chat snippets. The homepage line about dispatching 50 agents against 500 open issues hints at repo-scale work but is marketing copy, not documentation. Missing for 10: documented repo workflows (cloning, editing files, running tests), detail on which coding CLIs are supported and how they are supervised, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
